name: Aire Gardens
headline: A collection of design-led city apartments in a rare park-side setting
description: Aire Gardens is a collection of design-led city apartments set within a rare park-side setting at the heart of Leeds, adjacent to the South Bank regeneration and moments from the emerging Aire Park. Comprising 98 contemporary one-bedroom apartments ranging from 431 to 793 square feet, the development is arranged around a central open-air atrium with a retractable roof — a light-filled communal space that reflects the surrounding parkland. Just a short walk from Leeds Train Station, it places residents within immediate reach of the city's financial district, retail core and major transport links.
highlightedFeatures: Central open-air atrium with a retractable roof
Park-side setting adjacent to Aire Park and the South Bank regeneration
A short walk from Leeds Train Station

locationNotes: Nestled between Aire Park and the South Bank regeneration district. Leeds Train Station is a short walk away, and the city's financial district, retail core, dining scene and cultural venues are all within easy walking distance. By rail from Leeds: London 1hr 59min, Manchester 47min, Liverpool 1hr 25min, Newcastle 1hr 25min, Birmingham 1hr 58min, Edinburgh 2hr 50min.
